subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should maintainers require a fresh current-main Gateway restart reproduction before another fix PR, or accept a narrow repair for the source-proven protected-path rejection?
rationale: Source inspection proves the protected-path guard still rejects these documented config fields, but it does not prove the full restart-time deletion path reported by the issue.

options.title: Require restart proof first
options.body: Keep this issue in maintainer review until a current-main Gateway restart or config-write proof shows exactly where the values disappear.

options.title: Approve narrow allowlist repair
options.body: Allow a focused PR that adds only the documented bootstrap limit paths to the Gateway config mutation allowlist with guard tests and restart/config proof.

recommendation.title: Require restart proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue in maintainer review until a current-main Gateway restart or config-write proof shows exactly where the values disappear.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision centers on the protected Gateway config mutation boundary that pgondhi987 recently changed.
